title: MV Demiurge Sacrifice -  Weird, dark, RPG /farming sim | In development

posts.author: vampy_graveyard
posts.body:
Project in development.
​
Content Warning
​
Spoiler:
CW
Fantasy violence, horror-related themes (existential dread, violence,blood) strong afterlife and death references both in gameplay and story, dark religious themes in a supernatural way, surreal and bizarre visual aesthetics on many (but not all) maps
Introduction:
​
Demiurge Sacrifice is a surreal and dark farming-life simulator with RPG, soulslike and action elements,
Inspired by Giger, Yume Nikki and life/farming sims like Stardew Valley or Animal Crossing but with a nightmare-fuel twist. It's also the second game-project inspired both by the universe of the book ''The Masked Teacher'' and its franchise ''The Reverse Liturgy''.
This is a solo dev project with story, art direction and characters all made by the game's creator Vampy Graveyard.
This project will be released in two languages; spanish and english; but the dev is planning to add more languages as a future update of the game.
Story:
​
At this game you take the role of
Kadyr
, a young alien-demon prince who lives at a interdimensional realm and restarted his life after being chained and asleep for hundreds of years.
The game is structured with quests and two accesible worlds; Shapeless Dimension and human world
.  You have to deliver all sacrifices to the Mother of Empty Shapes
, then prepare yourself for the most important event of the human world; Feast of Abundance.
While you have these quests, you can explore the
Shapeless Dimension
and interact with it in a similar way to
life sims
and
farming games.
Both worlds have some similar features but Shapeless Dimension has a weird nightmare-fuel vibe to it.
Features:
​
-Battles as a main point of the game. They contain fictional violence and defeated enemies can serve as a interdimensional sacrifice or be captured as prisoners on Shapeless Dimension.
-A traveling system (with different travel points depending on the scenary!)  between Shapeless Dimension and the human world, including different parts of it.
-Varied NPC's on both dimensions moving and appearing with a in-game time system
-Farming and building system, you can decorate your home with weird items such as skeletons, fictional plants, etc
-Somewhat varied skill system with inspiration from Skyrim, RPG games and a bit from cozy games. Examples would be gardening, farming, fishing, grimdark variations of them and basically combat skills.

posts.author: vampy_graveyard
posts.body:
Devlog 12/15/2024
I am currently working on another map for a group of levels from my project's Human World. Here is a cropped preview of it. It's unfinished for now.
I've also been experimenting with patterns for this one and it's my second map design using Tiled.
The base image for this level was used with many tools and mixing techniques: RPG Maker basic tilesets, Tiled, my own custom tileset elements and now it's currently being edited with my main drawing/painting program. Krita.

posts.author: vampy_graveyard
posts.body:
Devlog 12/16/2024
I am working on another map level design for the Human World. Again, a work in progress.
This level design has a holy theme on it because this specific town of my game has religious themes on its lore and I thought this level adds very well to the vibe. Hopefully my next dev blog post will be either of this map or the other one with new updates.
This time I didn't use Tiled, I just used RPG Maker editor with default tilesets as a guide then drew over it to the point the reference isn't recognizable at all.

If you refer to the bust, the gray lines behind are a sketch/lineart used as a base to paint the pixel art. I tend to apply this technique for my lineless paintings and some of my pixel art. It's a good technique in my opinion but I wouldn't recommend it to a very beginner. I used to struggle with doin it well at first.
Thank you for your good vibes! I am putting a lot of dedication on this project.
